craft_notes: Sthāyin: unsmearable (either way awake). Rows: row 3 (unbroken→awake). Close: awake (nityaprabuddha as the standing epithet). Rejected: 'pure' for stainless — no stain-word here; kept smeared (the verse's own verb); 'whether' flattening — kept shine-or-not (the either-or IS the structure).

lines: Being-illuminer — stained by them, what is that to you?
shine or not, your greatness holds unbroken;
both ways unrestrained, unfettered, delusion unbroken, ever content,
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhāvānām avabhāsako 'si yadi tair mālinyam ātanyate | kiṃ te tad yadi bhāti hanta bhavatas tatrāpy akhaṇḍaṃ mahaḥ | no cen nāsti tad evam apy ubhayathā nirvyājaniryantraṇātruṭyadvibhramanityatṛptamahimā nityaprabuddho 'si bhoḥ

reads_against.argmap: What if the illuminator is smeared? → Smearing cannot touch the illuminator: shining or not, greatness stays unbroken; both alternatives dissolve into ever-awake being.
c1_essence: The illuminator smeared or not stays unbroken in greatness — ever-awake either way.
